title: Cattle Daddy Round Ups: Create, Educate and Amplify Cardano at Crypto Events

ms.promise: 1 x Research and Event Analysis report for our Cattle Daddy Round Up Campaign.
ms.criteria:
The Research and Event Analysis report should include the following:
・Information from our in-depth research on the events, attendees, speakers, and exhibitors to assist us in our content planning stages.
・Key messaging and themes to ensure alignment with Cardano's goals and values.
・Community Mapping: Identify and establish connections with Key Opinion Leaders and Partners.
・A resource plan detailing the utilities, resources, and equipment needed to order in advance of the events for content creation.
ms.report:
This report demonstrates that we have successfully met the Outputs, Acceptance Criteria, and Evidence of Milestone Completion outlined in Milestone 1 of Cattle Daddy Round Ups.
Specifically, this report showcases In-Depth Research and Event Analysis, along with key resources and documentation. Through research, strategic content planning, detailed resource management, and proactive risk mitigation, we have laid a solid foundation for the successful execution of the Round Up Campaign, starting with execution of Milestone 1. 
Thank you.

ms.report:
Thank you for your feedback! Taking your points into account, we're pleased to share our updated submission with improvements for clarity and completeness.
While some content pieces, such as skits, were creatively relevant to both events, we have now clearly tagged each video according to its primary event to avoid any confusion regarding delivery scope. Additionally, the full-length recap videos have been included and clearly labeled, as requested.
Skits were delivered and performed exceptionally well, including one of the highest-performing posts across all milestones. We also produced reels, highlight edits, and a variety of engaging content formats, demonstrating our commitment to both creativity and audience impact.
Finally, now that we have the supporting data, we’ve added a section outlining a stretch goal we undertook: expanding the project scope to include coverage of the Cardano Constitutional Convention and Cardano Tech Week in Argentina - two major community events of 2024 we felt were important to document and share.
